A generous max_image_size accommodates a small data-URI image without warnings

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_images\":true,\"max_image_size\":10485760}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Image: <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
